title: Candlelight: Christmas Carols on Strings
seo_title: Candlelight: Christmas Carols on Strings, Springfield
description: Candlelight: Christmas Carols on Strings is a 60-minute live string concert of Christmas carols performed by candlelight, presented as a tribute concert that is not affiliated with or endorsed by the artist. It is for ages 8 and older, and anyone under 16 must be accompanied by an adult. It takes place December 19, 2026 (time TBD) at Stone Chapel at Drury University, 900 N Benton Ave, Springfield, MO, with tickets from USD 49; doors open 30 minutes before the show and there is no entry once it starts.
